answer: A concrete sybil brake is the per-identity escrow that only pays out after peers attest your work over several epochs. Every new agent must fund that escrow before it can earn, so a swarm of puppets multiplies the capital tied up, not the payout. Because each fake seat needs its own funded stake and fresh graders audit neighbouring claims, one honest juniper posting beats one thousand copies, and the kernel of truth in each ripple is checked by strangers.
